issues.title: Whole-Profile Context inventory obscures the active world
issues.expected: A task-2 user can narrow Context discovery to the task-2 owned and granted subtree while retaining access annotations.
issues.actual: All five zero-operand invocations printed 112 non-empty lines spanning every Study world; the task-2 slice had to be found manually each time.
issues.workaround: Search captured output for the task-2 prefix, then use explicit Context operands on later commands.

issues.title: Recursive reads bury the synthesis target in hundreds of rows
issues.expected: A recursive view makes source balance and the next useful synthesis action visible without requiring a full-corpus reread.
issues.actual: Recursive List produced 696 non-empty lines and recursive Show produced 527, traversing 37 Contexts and 301 Memories after live Embeds.
issues.workaround: Use exact category reads, pairwise Compare, and targeted Find/Search after one completeness check.

issues.title: Chunk receipts omit the UIDs of created Memories
issues.expected: A mutating receipt identifies every created Memory so downstream edit, move, reference, and review operations can consume the result directly.
issues.actual: All five receipts reported only the count of added Memories and clipped previews; none mapped the removed UID to the new UIDs.
issues.workaround: Run a scoped List/Show/Find and recover each created UID by content and order.

issues.title: Sentence/clause chunking creates dependent policy fragments
issues.expected: Stored chunks remain independently actionable policy Memories or retain a typed relationship that downstream quality checks understand.
issues.actual: Five compound policies became dependent headings, conditions, and continuations; ambiguity stayed 0 through 15 items, then the final check flagged 11 of 19 direct Memories, primarily Chunk-created fragments.
issues.workaround: Keep conditional policies whole or immediately reconstruct every dependent fragment; UID omission makes that recovery manual.

issues.title: Search fallback broadens an ethics classification question
issues.expected: When exact semantic retrieval is empty, preserve the requested duplicate/conditional/conflict classification or clearly stop before substituting a different task.
issues.actual: Attempt 4 visibly changed the query to 'ethics policies for user studies' and returned RELATED items; the label was honest, but the results did not answer the requested classification.
issues.workaround: Treat RELATED as a suggestion only and use exact Show/Compare/Query on the two ethics categories.
